name: @pipeworx/mcp-zenquotes

tools.name: random_quote
tools.description: Fetch a single random inspirational quote (author + text) from ZenQuotes; falls back to dummyjson automatically if ZenQuotes is unavailable. Response includes _source field when served from fallback.

tools.name: today_quote
tools.description: Get the quote of the day from ZenQuotes. Returns the same quote for all requests within a given day.

tools.name: list_quotes
tools.description: Fetch a batch of up to 50 random inspirational quotes (author + text each) from ZenQuotes; falls back to dummyjson if ZenQuotes is unavailable. Response includes count, quotes array, and _source when from fallback.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-zenquotes forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the zenquotes pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
